narrative_prose: Ryn adjusted the heavy brass ladle, measuring the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea by the vibrations in the copper stockpot. The broth bubbled steadily, a small comfort against the harsh environment outside. She filled a bowl, the savory aroma cutting through the ozone tang of the forge next door. With a nod, she handed the warm bowl directly to Silas, ensuring the next watch was well-fed.
